svg.title: Which energy does the write measurement include?
svg.desc: Integrating voltage times current gives device energy. A memory product also needs energy for peripheral circuits.
svg.text: Write energy depends on pulse power and duration
Integrate voltage times current over time

g.text: What a short pulse can reduce
Write energy delivered to the device
Check voltage, current, and the comparison baseline
Pulse generator + address selection + wiring losses + read circuit + error correction
Estimating data-center power requires more than a device write-energy measurement.
